description: Google Jobs. Scrape Google Jobs results via API and retrieve structured job listings with title, company, location, and pagination. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

cr.description: Limit results to one or more countries. Use country{XX} with | as delimiter (e.g. countryFR|countryDE).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country to use for the Google search. Two-letter country code (e.g. us for the United States, uk for United Kingdom, or fr for France). Default: "us".

google_domain.description: Google domain to use for the search. Defaults to google.com. Default: "google.com".

hl.description: Language to use for the Google search. Two or three-letter language code (e.g. en, es, fr), optionally followed by a region code (e.g. en-gb, es-419). Default: "en".

location.description: Human-readable location to originate the search from (e.g. New York, NY, Paris, France). If several locations match, the most popular one is used. Note: location and uule cannot be used together.

lr.description: Limit results to one or more languages. Use lang_{xx} with | as delimiter (e.g. lang_fr|lang_de).

lrad.description: Search radius in kilometers. Does not strictly limit the radius, but influences result proximity.

ltype.description: Filter results by work type. Set to 1 to filter for work from home / remote jobs.

next_page_token.description: Token to fetch the next page of results. Returned in the serpapi_pagination.next_page_token field of the previous response.

query.description: The job search query to run on Google Jobs (e.g. developer, barista new york).

uds.description: Advanced search filters string for Google Jobs (encoded filter chips).

uule.description: Google encoded location parameter. Use for precise geo targeting. Note: uule and location cannot be used together.

name: google_jobs
title: Google Jobs
